_doc: Default analysis regions per capture tag for Tools/qa (format: see the docstring of Tools/qa/qa_common.py).
Coordinates are pixels at 1920 x 1080 ('ref') scaled per axis to the image, unless 'units' says otherwise.
Entries apply to 16:9 images (1080p and 4K) unless 'aspect' says otherwise. report.json 'regions' per shot are merged on top.
Wave B (integrate): the atmosphere owner's Wave A regions. BandScore regions from the 14.10.3 'Banding region' column
(KS04 storm sky, KS05 haze, KS08 sky, KS20 dusk sky), the horizon pairs as trend-removed steps ('mode': 'trend': a line
per channel fitted to rows h-7..h-2 and h+2..h+7, extrapolated to h, Lab dE <= 2.0; rows from the visibility audit:
KS04 sea horizon 840 / 2160 = 420 at 1080, KS20 lowland horizon 948 / 2160 = 474), and the 2.5 deg sun-disc exclusion
('azEl': 'sun' takes the shot's report.json 'sun' [az, el], written by CaptureHarness from BulwarkSchedule at the shot's s).

Fix wave X2 (lead QA): b08_* ending stills = A1 4.10 beats 8 (ride, sun disc 2.5 deg excluded) and 9 (platform; the Keeper's Lantern core excluded); banding in the dusk sky (KS22/KS23), the face gradient (KS24), the alpenglow (KS28) and the sky above the crest (KS29).
